headline: Walmart's effort to hand its warehouses over to robots is running into practical difficulties, the Wall Street Journal reports.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: the difficulties, costs and timelines could not be checked against the article text.
importance_line: Warehouse workers and Walmart's suppliers are the people most affected by how fast automation spreads, but the obstacles, costs and timetable are not stated here, so the size of the setback is unknown.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports on 14 Oct 2026 that Walmart, the US retail chain, wants robots to run its warehouses but is meeting practical obstacles in doing so.
notes: Wall Street Journal needs a subscription (HTTP 401) and no other outlet carrying the story was found, so this is headline only. A second Journal headline the same morning, 'Walmart Wrangles With Complexities of Warehouse Automation', points to the same piece. Headline-only, so the score is lowered by 1.
